CA.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and a processing-origin (command_estimate) are explicitly co-located for a candidate node.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates, a presentation/access statement (current), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same node/attribute.

A.rationale: A processing-origin label (command_estimate) is explicitly tied to the same candidate node's red content.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (node p0/current/n2) and an attribute (red coordinates).

D.rationale: Content coordinates are presented separately from an explicit origin/status field for the same node, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: Nodes are labeled as current/candidate with explicit coordinate sets and origin/presentation metadata, describing how content is presented/accessed.
